334: export function recommendedLevel(chapterIndex) {
335:   return Math.min(LEVEL_CAP, 2 + Math.floor(chapterIndex * 0.95));
336: }
337: 
338: export function lootForChapter(chapterIndex) {
339:   const band = LOOT_BANDS.find(b => chapterIndex < b.max) || LOOT_BANDS[LOOT_BANDS.length - 1];
340:   return band.items;
341: }
342: 
343: export function rollLoot(chapterIndex, rng = Math.random) {
344:   const items = lootForChapter(chapterIndex);
345:   return items[Math.floor(rng() * items.length)];
346: }
347: 
348: function pickWeapon(job, chapterIndex) {
349:   const type = job.weapons[0] || 'sword';
350:   const tier = Math.min(4, Math.floor(chapterIndex / 4));
351:   const list = WEAPON_TIERS[type] || WEAPON_TIERS.sword;
352:   const id = list[Math.min(tier, list.length - 1)];
353:   return ITEM_MAP[id];
354: }

356: /**
357:  * Build a scaled enemy. `spec` is compact:
358:  * { role, name?, level?, pos, boss?, elite?, leader?, undead?, beast?,
359:  *   dropId?, abilities?, weaponId?, mult? }
360:  * Scaling deliberately tracks the player's deployed average so every
361:  * chapter stays challenging but never becomes a wall.
362:  */
363: export function buildEnemy(spec, chapterIndex, avgLevel = recommendedLevel(chapterIndex)) {
364:   const role = spec.role || 'soldier';
365:   const adv = ADVANCED[role];
366:   const baseKey = adv ? adv.base : role;
367:   const base = ARCHETYPES[baseKey] || ARCHETYPES.soldier;
368:   const jobId = spec.job || (adv ? adv.job : base.job);
369:   const job = JOBS[jobId] || JOBS.squire;
370:   const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(30, spec.level || recommendedLevel(chapterIndex)));
371:   const expected = recommendedLevel(chapterIndex);
372:   const catchUp = Math.max(0.84, Math.min(1.32, 1 + (avgLevel - expected) * 0.065));
373:   const chapterScale = 1 + chapterIndex * 0.012;
374:   const tierMult = (adv ? adv.mult : 1) * (spec.mult || 1);
375:   const bossMult = spec.boss ? 1 : 1;
376:   const hpBoss = spec.boss ? (spec.final ? 2.6 : 2.1) : 1;
377:   const statBoss = spec.boss ? 1.14 : 1;
378:   const elite = spec.elite ? 1.16 : 1;
379:   const m = tierMult * catchUp * chapterScale * statBoss * elite;
380: 
381:   const weapon = spec.weaponId ? ITEM_MAP[spec.weaponId] : pickWeapon(job, chapterIndex);
382:   const arts = (spec.abilities && spec.abilities.length)
383:     ? spec.abilities.map(getArt).filter(Boolean)
384:     : job.arts.slice(0, Math.max(2, Math.min(5, 1 + Math.floor(level / 4))));
385: 
386:   const stats = {
387:     maxHp: Math.round((base.hp + base.hpG * (level - 1)) * m * hpBoss),
388:     maxMp: Math.round((8 + level * 2 + (job.bonus.mp || 0)) * (spec.boss ? 1.4 : 1)),
389:     pa: Math.round((base.pa + base.paG * (level - 1)) * m),
390:     ma: Math.round((base.ma + base.maG * (level - 1)) * m),
391:     def: Math.round((base.def + base.defG * (level - 1)) * m),
392:     res: Math.round((base.res + base.resG * (level - 1)) * m),
393:     spd: Math.round((base.spd + base.spdG * (level - 1)) * Math.min(1.25, m)),
394:     move: job.move,
395:     jump: job.jump,
396:   };
397: 
398:   const names = ENEMY_NAMES[role] || ENEMY_NAMES.soldier;
399:   const name = spec.name || names[(chapterIndex + spec.pos[0] + spec.pos[1]) % names.length];
400: 
401:   return {
402:     name,
403:     job: jobId,
404:     level,
405:     pos: spec.pos,
406:     stats,
407:     weapon: {
408:       name: weapon.name,
409:       atk: weapon.atk || 0,
410:       mag: weapon.mag || 0,
411:       range: weapon.range || 1,
412:       type: weapon.type || 'sword',
413:       id: weapon.id,
414:     },
415:     abilities: arts.map(a => a.id),
416:     boss: !!spec.boss,
417:     final: !!spec.final,
418:     leader: !!spec.leader || !!spec.boss,
419:     elite: !!spec.elite,
420:     undead: !!spec.undead,
421:     beast: !!spec.beast,
422:     dropId: spec.dropId || null,
423:     dropChance: spec.boss ? 1 : (spec.elite ? 0.55 : 0.34),
424:     xp: Math.round((spec.boss ? 55 : 18) + level * (spec.boss ? 5 : 2.6)),
425:     color: job.color,
426:     role,
427:   };
428: }

playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file
  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)
  cookie-get <name>           get a specific cookie by name
  cookie-set <name> <value>   set a cookie with optional flags
  cookie-delete <name>        delete a specific cookie
  cookie-clear                clear all cookies
  localstorage-list           list all localstorage key-value pairs
  localstorage-get <key>      get a localstorage item by key
  localstorage-set <key> <value> set a localstorage item
  localstorage-delete <key>   delete a localstorage item
  localstorage-clear          clear all localstorage
  sessionstorage-list         list all sessionstorage key-value pairs
  sessionstorage-get <key>    get a sessionstorage item by key
  sessionstorage-set <key> <value> set a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-delete <key> delete a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-clear        clear all sessionstorage

Network:
  requests                    list all network requests since loading the page. each request is numbered for use with the `request` command.
  request <index>             show full details (headers, body, response) of a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-headers <index>     print only the request headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-body <index>        print only the request body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.

## Objective
- Continue and finish the existing “The Hollow Crown” tactical RPG web game in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`; it had a complete index/CSS/data/state/chapters/sprites/audio/UI but was missing `js/main.js` and the second half of `js/battle.js`.

## Requirements
- Build a complete, playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly at finish.
- Mobile/desktop support expected from existing project notes: responsive layouts, usable touch controls, safe-area visibility, no gesture conflicts.
- Preserve existing game structure, style, and modules.

## Decisions
- Implemented `js/main.js` as the full application shell: title, story, camp, shop, unit/job/art/equipment/promotion modals, deployment, battle hand-off, results, codex, credits, saving.
- Completed `js/battle.js` with turn flow, CT ticking, statuses, art/item/summon resolution, enemy AI, board/button input, victory/defeat, threat display, sound toggle, cleanup.
- Story intros play only once per encounter (`state.seenIntros`); outs always play after victory.
- Consumables are deducted only on victory; defeat returns to camp with state unchanged.
- Auto-save at camp entry, after rewards, purchases, job/art/equipment/promotion changes, and saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- `js/main.js` created and syntactically valid.
- `js/battle.js` completed and syntactically valid; imports updated for `isMuted`, `toggleMute`.
- Fixed `PROLOGUE` import to come from `js/chapters.js`.
- Browser-tested title screen, new game, prologue story, skip, camp, unit modal, march/intro, battle board, movement, Wait, enemy AI turns, attack/kill, victory result, outro, camp after victory, Vey recruitment, gold/loot/EXP/JP progression.
- Screenshots captured: `screenshots/title.png`, `story.png`, `camp.png`, `unit.png`, `battle.png`, `result.png`, `camp2.png`.

### Active

1. Test Armory buy flow, Chronicle tab, Codex, unit gear/job/learn/promote interactions.
2. Test defeat path by losing a battle or manipulating battle state, then confirm camp retry.
3. Test responsive/mobile viewport with `playwright-cli resize` and verify board/dock usability.
4. Fix any discovered issues, run `node --check` on changed JS files, then commit with a concise message.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: newly created app shell; main integration point.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/battle.js`: completed battle engine; verify AI/art/input paths.
